schema.environment: DOOM-compatible first-person shooter using standard movement, turning, weapon-fire, and use controls.
schema.objective: Play the current DOOM episode using only the observed game state and available controller inputs.

actionSpace.description: The policy reasons over orthogonal movement, view, trigger, and interaction axes; each candidate still resolves to a literal controller-button packet and never encodes a tactical macro.

actionFields.label: movement
actionFields.description: translation choice for this control interval

actionFields.label: view change
actionFields.description: view rotation choice for this control interval

actionFields.label: weapon trigger
actionFields.description: whether to fire the equipped weapon this interval

actionFields.label: environment interaction
actionFields.description: whether to activate a usable line or object this interval

fields.label: health
fields.description: remaining player vitality

fields.label: armor
fields.description: remaining protective armor

fields.label: bullets
fields.description: available pistol or chaingun ammunition

fields.label: shells
fields.description: available shotgun ammunition

fields.label: rockets
fields.description: available rocket launcher ammunition

fields.label: cells
fields.description: available plasma or BFG energy ammunition

fields.label: recent damage received
fields.description: damage registered on the player in the recent engine combat window

fields.label: recent hostile HP loss
fields.description: hostile hit points removed during the previous control interval from any cause; observational telemetry that may include monster infighting

fields.label: recent player-attributed hostile damage
fields.description: hostile hit points removed during the previous control interval with the player recorded by the engine as the damage source; zero when attribution telemetry is unavailable

fields.label: recent player-attributed kills
fields.description: hostile kills during the previous control interval with the player recorded by the engine as source; zero when attribution telemetry is unavailable

fields.label: recent player pickups
fields.description: successful item pickups by the player during the previous control interval

fields.label: level completed
fields.description: whether the engine completed a level during the previous control interval

fields.label: secret exit
fields.description: whether the completed level used a secret exit during the previous control interval

fields.label: under fire
fields.description: whether the engine currently reports recent incoming damage

fields.label: equipped weapon
fields.description: weapon currently equipped by the player

fields.label: player x position
fields.description: player world x coordinate

fields.label: player y position
fields.description: player world y coordinate

fields.label: player z position
fields.description: player world vertical coordinate

fields.label: player x velocity
fields.description: player horizontal x momentum

fields.label: player y velocity
fields.description: player horizontal y momentum

fields.label: player heading
fields.description: player view angle as a signed normalized turn

fields.label: intermission kill count
fields.description: single-player Chocolate Doom kill statistic; may include monster deaths caused by other monsters and is therefore telemetry, not player-attributed reward

fields.label: visited spatial cells
fields.description: number of distinct coarse player-position cells visited this episode

fields.label: current cell visits
fields.description: number of control transitions ending in the current coarse spatial cell

fields.label: exploration novelty
fields.description: inverse revisit count of the current spatial cell; higher means less familiar

collections.label: world entities
collections.description: dynamic actors, objects and pickups represented with absolute and player-relative state

fields.label: engine record id
fields.description: numeric record identifier supplied by the engine

fields.label: entity type
fields.description: engine object category

fields.label: entity kind
fields.description: coarse factual engine category of this record

fields.label: entity x position
fields.description: entity absolute world x coordinate

fields.label: entity y position
fields.description: entity absolute world y coordinate

fields.label: entity z position
fields.description: entity absolute world vertical coordinate

fields.label: relative x
fields.description: entity x displacement from the player

fields.label: relative y
fields.description: entity y displacement from the player

fields.label: relative z
fields.description: entity z displacement from the player

fields.label: entity x velocity
fields.description: entity x momentum

fields.label: entity y velocity
fields.description: entity y momentum

fields.label: entity radius
fields.description: physical collision radius

fields.label: entity height
fields.description: physical collision height

fields.label: entity health
fields.description: remaining actor health when applicable

fields.label: distance
fields.description: distance from player to entity

fields.label: relative angle
fields.description: signed angular displacement from the player's view

fields.label: line of sight
fields.description: whether the engine reports direct line of sight

fields.label: hostile actor flag
fields.description: whether this actor counts toward the level hostile kill total

fields.label: collectible flag
fields.description: whether this engine object is collectible or special

fields.label: targets player
fields.description: whether this actor currently targets the player

collections.label: world geometry
collections.description: map line segments represented relative to the player

fields.label: line id
fields.description: numeric map line identifier

fields.label: line endpoint one x
fields.description: first endpoint x displacement from player

fields.label: line endpoint one y
fields.description: first endpoint y displacement from player

fields.label: line endpoint two x
fields.description: second endpoint x displacement from player

fields.label: line endpoint two y
fields.description: second endpoint y displacement from player

fields.label: line flags
fields.description: numeric engine bit flags attached to this map line

fields.label: blocking geometry
fields.description: whether this line blocks player movement

fields.label: interactive line special
fields.description: numeric engine special action attached to the line

fields.label: line tag
fields.description: numeric map linkage tag attached to the line

actions.label: strafe left
actions.description: move sideways left while keeping the current view direction

actions.label: strafe right
actions.description: move sideways right while keeping the current view direction

actions.label: forward + fire
actions.description: hold forward movement and weapon fire at the same time

actions.label: back + fire
actions.description: hold backward movement and weapon fire at the same time

actions.label: strafe left + fire
actions.description: hold left strafe and weapon fire at the same time

actions.label: strafe right + fire
actions.description: hold right strafe and weapon fire at the same time

actions.label: turn left + fire
actions.description: turn left and fire the equipped weapon at the same time

actions.label: turn right + fire
actions.description: turn right and fire the equipped weapon at the same time

actions.label: interact / open
actions.description: press the use key to open doors, activate switches, lifts, or other usable map elements directly ahead

actions.label: wait
actions.description: apply no movement, turning, firing, or use input for this decision interval
